Rival Racer Saves Driver From Burning Car in China GT Race

Race car driver Ollie Millroy expressed gratitude to rival Loek Hartog for saving his life during a China GT race in Shanghai. Following a crash, Millroy's Ferrari caught fire, and Hartog pulled him from the burning vehicle. The incident occurred during a race in Shanghai.
